name: thibaudeau-kayak-row
instructions:
1. Attach a medium width handle to a cable stack and assume a standing position.
2. Grasp the handle with a pronated grip (double overhand) at roughly shoulder width.
3. Keep the elbow slightly flexed and initiate the movement by depressing the shoulder blade, extending the shoulder, and laterally flexing the spine to maximally contract the lat.
4. Pull one side of the bar towards your thigh until the lat is fully contracted and then slowly lower under control.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions on both sides.
